mintAuthority.summary: Canonical thBILL transfers supported collateral before minting shares, but its accepted tULTRA receipt permits privileged optimistic issuance without receiving underlying assets. Theo's service router and delegated signing account can create those receipts and deposit them into thBILL. Governance upgrades remain timelocked; the live optimistic issuance path is not.

controls.label: thBILL ERC-4626 multi-asset wrapper
controls.capDescription: Public deposit and mint create thBILL shares only after the wrapper transfers the corresponding quantity of an accepted collateral asset from the caller; the wrapper exposes no uncollateralized or privileged raw-mint path.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25712112, asset() returned USDC 0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48 and depositAssetsList() returned supported asset 0x82b840b6edf77f90c92a70b99f0b5d50e7967330. The verified ERC-4626 multi-asset implementation transfers the requested collateral from the caller before internally minting shares; it exposes no privileged external raw-mint function.

controls.label: thBILL UUPS upgrade timelock
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25712112, this TimelockController was the sole live thBILL DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holder and getMinDelay() returned 172800 seconds. Verified IToken source gates UUPS upgrades, emergency-role administration, deposit-asset/config changes, and other AccessControl administration through DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE.

controls.label: Theo governance Safe (timelock proposer/executor/canceller)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25712112, Safe state was 4-of-6, version 1.4.1, with the listed owners, no enabled modules, and zero guard. Timelock role checks confirmed this Safe holds PROPOSER_ROLE, EXECUTOR_ROLE, and CANCELLER_ROLE; it can therefore schedule and execute thBILL administration and UUPS upgrades after the two-day delay.

controls.label: Theo thBILL optimistic mint service router
controls.capDescription: The router holds MINTER_ROLE on the accepted tULTRA receipt. Its privileged caller supplies tTokenAssets independently of amountAssetIn; the receipt mints against pending assets without transferring underlying and the router deposits those shares into canonical thBILL. No economic issuance cap was identified on this active path.

review.evidence: Review on 2026-10-09 at Ethereum block 26154579 (0xaeb74e22f56f812a995351bb758eea9cfb274344c7b0fd438042e8c595ba7c21; 2026-10-09T11:33:35Z), with role census observed 2026-10-09T11:48:02.755Z. Canonical thBILL's verified IToken implementation remains 0x325478a069b0dbbdfbee909fa3741f84259ba519 and the vault is not paused. Its direct deposit/mint still transfers collateral, but accepted tULTRA 0x82b840b6edf77f90c92a70b99f0b5d50e7967330 has active privileged optimistic issuance against pending assets rather than receipt of underlying assets. Router 0x8a2c307d1462ff4fa98c9c119d3a3457ad505eb1 holds that receipt's MINTER_ROLE; its own complete birth-to-pin role census and pinned hasRole reads establish sole minter 0x0f21ee679e40123dea03cc64983035ce24bffcf3 and sole admin timelock 0x2bb4b7e6e83fa6b77d0143dad631843cb73dca02. A pinned authorized router simulation with zero USDC input and positive tTokenAssets reaches canonical share issuance without reverting. The original all-path raiseable-collateral-only proof considered the outer vault only and is removed, not re-dated: an accepted receipt transfer is not proof of independent collateral receipt. Economic cap semantics are unbounded and posture unbounded-adverse for this evidenced issuance power; no exploit, incident, reserve loss or collateralization ratio is asserted. The timelock's minimum delay remains 172800 seconds at this pin, but the already-authorized optimistic mint path has no such delay. Historical Safe/quorum observations are preserved at their original dates. Receipt/admin/EntryPoint execution outside the demonstrated path and the complete cross-deployment liability inventory remain open; the partial router certificate grants no full-execution, governed-process, custody, reconciliation or supervision credit.
